args.body: Hi Imogen, thanks for getting back to us. Please treat the gassy smell as urgent. Please don't use the oven or hob, and don't use any switches, flames or sockets near it. Open windows if you can, leave the flat, and call the National Gas Emergency line on 0800 111 999 (free, 24 hours). Call 999 if you are in immediate danger. Please don't go back in until they say it is safe. We are arranging a Gas Safe registered engineer to attend as an emergency, with a same-day target, and we'll update you once we have a time. The oven not heating will be looked at as part of that visit. Please don't use the previous settings advice any more. We'll be in touch again today.
